subject: Evidence delivery milestones, credits, and billing split for compliance add-ons
body:
From: Samantha Taylor <samantha.taylor@meridianhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@meridianhealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Clarification on HSM vs metering + evidence schedule for compliance add-ons

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the call earlier. Two quick asks from our procurement and security teams so we can move the SOW forward:

1) Can you provide a short matrix that shows pricing scenarios for KMS/HSM: (a) seat-based HSM licensing amortized over 12 months, (b) per-call metering (monthly), and (c) a blended pass-through for FedRAMP/residency requirements? We need line items to map to our PO.

2) For audit evidence (audit logs + SOC2 supplement + HSM attestation), Meridian needs written milestones tied to credits/concessions — e.g., evidence delivered at 90/180 days. Is Redwood comfortable with milestone-triggered credits or do you require full up-front implementation fees?

Attaching our procurement template for formatting (Procurement_Template_Meridian.pdf). Can you get a short reply by EOD Thursday? We’re trying to close this by next week.

Thanks,
Samantha Taylor
Director, IT Procurement
Meridian Health

---

On 2026-12-18 11:05 AM, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com> wrote:
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Taylor <samantha.taylor@meridianhealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@meridianhealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-18T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on HSM vs metering + evidence schedule for compliance add-ons

Hi Samantha — really appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers and then a proposal below.

Short answer: Yes — we can support all three pricing paths. We typically recommend one of the following depending on scale and residency needs:

- Seat-based HSM (amortized): one-time implementation + monthly amortization of HSM seat(s) across 12 months. Predictable cost, simpler audit scoping.
- Per-call metering: Opex-friendly, you pay per-use; better for low or spiky throughput.
- Blended pass-through: we pass HSM licensing or cloud-residency pass-through costs and apply a small platform premium (useful for strict residency/SaaS restrictions).

Proposal for concessions tied to evidence:
- We can offer a Year-1 volume rebate of 10% on committed token throughput if Meridian accepts the following milestones:
  * Milestone 1 (90 days): delivery of audit evidence pack (audit logs + HSM attestation + SOC2 supplement). Trigger: 5% credit applied as invoice credit / one-time implementation credit.
  * Milestone 2 (180 days): completion of residency verification and HSM operational testing. Trigger: remaining 5% credit applied to recurring invoices.

Attached: compliance_pricing_matrix.xlsx (three pricing scenarios + sample invoice mapping).

Two clarifying Qs:
1) Do you prefer credits applied as a one-time implementation refund or recurring invoice credit?
2) Will Meridian accept staged evidence (90/180 days) or do you need the full package at 90 days?

If you like this path I’ll loop in Laura in Revenue Ops to confirm accounting mapping and Ben for the SOW/redline.

Best,
Markus
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: compliance_pricing_matrix.xlsx (pricing matrix), draft_example_quote.pdf (stub)

---

From: Samantha Taylor <samantha.taylor@meridianhealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@meridianhealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-19T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on HSM vs metering + evidence schedule for compliance add-ons

Markus — thanks, that structure helps. A few clarifications from our side:

- Meridian’s security team prefers the 90/180 staged evidence approach rather than all-or-nothing at 90 days. 90 days must include: audit log export templates, HSM attestation stub, and SOC2 supplement draft (we can review). The 180-day must include final attestation + residency checklist.
- Implementation fee: can you cap the non-recurring implementation portion at $75k and apply any overage to the first invoice as amortized HSM seats?
- Credits: procurement prefers invoice credits (recurring) rather than one-off refunds to keep accounting tidy.

If you can send a redline SOW and an updated quote that shows the capped implementation fee + the 10% year-one rebate mapped to invoice credits, we’ll circulate to legal and procurement.

Samantha

---

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-19T14:30:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Meridian evidence schedule + pricing asks — approval on rebate and invoice mapping

Laura / Ben — forwarding Meridian’s asks. Key asks:
- They want 10% Y1 rebate tied to evidence at 90/180 days, applied as invoice credits (procurement request).
- Cap implementation at $75k and amortize any HSM seat over 12 months (they explicitly requested amortization).

My recommendation: approve the 10% Y1 rebate but split the credit application: 50% applied as implementation credit (to reduce the initial PO amount) and 50% as recurring invoice credits over the first 6 months. Rationale: keeps Meridian happy with invoice credits while preserving accounting visibility for Redwood.

Ben — can you confirm the engineering SOW timeline (90/180 day deliverables)?
Laura — can Revenue Ops confirm accounting treatment for the split credit (implementation credit + recurring credits) and whether we need a revenue deferral schedule? Also confirm whether this treatment is acceptable from a GAAP/revenue recognition standpoint.

Thanks,
Markus

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-19T16:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Meridian evidence schedule + pricing asks — approval on rebate and invoice mapping

Markus / Laura —

90/180 is fine from engineering; we can deliver the artifacts as follows:
- 90 days: audit log export formats, SOC2 supplement draft, HSM attestation (preliminary).
- 180 days: final attestation, residency verification report, operational runbook.

I recommend we list the 90-day deliverables as "Preliminary Evidence Pack (for procurement review)" and the 180-day as "Final Evidence & Attestation" in the SOW. That wording plays better for legal.

From a billing perspective we can map the 5% credit to an invoice line labeled "Milestone credit — Evidence (90d)" and the remaining 5% to "Milestone credit — Evidence (180d)". If Revenue Ops prefers a different label we can adjust.

Ben

---

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Samantha Taylor <samantha.taylor@meridianhealth.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Meridian evidence schedule + pricing asks — approval on rebate and invoice mapping

Markus / Ben / Samantha —

We will approve the maneuver with the following guardrails:

1) Financial: Redwood will offer the 10% Year-1 rebate with the following invoice mapping: 50% applied against the implementation PO as an implementation credit (reduces the first invoice up to $37.5k) and 50% applied as recurring invoice credits spread evenly over the first 6 billing cycles. This keeps our revenue recognition simpler and meets Meridian’s preference for invoice credits.

2) Implementation cap: we will cap the non-recurring implementation at $75,000 as requested. Any overage will be invoiced and subject to pre-approval by Meridian.

3) Evidence milestones & attachments: 90-day Preliminary Evidence Pack must include the items Ben listed (audit log exports, SOC2 supplement draft, HSM attestation stub). 180-day Final Evidence must include final attestation and residency verification. Delivery of the PDF evidence artifact will be made available via secure Drive link; please reference the audit_evidence_pack.pdf we will produce.

4) SOW language: Ben — please update the SOW to use the two-phased language ("Preliminary Evidence Pack (90d)" and "Final Evidence & Attestation (180d)") and attach the Draft_MA_SOW.docx for legal redline. I will route to Finance for the deferral schedule and confirm GAAP treatment.

Next steps: Markus, send Meridian an updated quote + SOW with the credit mapping and attachments. I will notify Finance & Legal and confirm by EOD tomorrow.

Laura Bennett
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced in thread (stubs):
- compliance_pricing_matrix.xlsx (pricing scenarios)
- audit_evidence_pack.pdf (deliverable to Meridian at 90/180 days)
- Draft_MA_SOW.docx (SOW for redline)
